messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: service=canary-gateway, trigger=deploy_canary_503s, urgency=high. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incident/INC12345
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident INC12345 created and notified: escalation_policy=oncall-sre -> level2.
Dana L (oncall): acked via PagerDuty, jumping in. @Ryan S can you grab logs + flame?
Ryan S (sre): On it. quick glance: canary hosts returning 503s on /v1/generate. P95 token latency spiking, 5xx rate ~28% on canary cohort.
Ryan S (sre): grabbing logs from pod canary-rc-9f8d
Ryan S (sre): ```
[2026-03-15T02:10:12Z] ERROR http: /v1/generate -> upstream: upstream-embed-connector timeout
[2026-03-15T02:10:13Z] 503 response to client, connection reset
[2026-03-15T02:10:13Z] kv-cache miss: large sequence length, fallback path
```
Maya P (deploy-owner): I'm watching the rollout we just pushed at 02:05 UTC (image: inference:release-2026-03-15-canary). Marking as potential regression. Rolling back canary now?
Dana L (oncall): yes, agree we should roll back the canary variant only. Tracing shows the failing pods are the new image. Not yet widespread.
Jenn K (product): any customer impact determined? support pinged that some early customers saw 5xx in logs. Need customer comm if it expands.
Ryan S (sre): stack traces show a quantization path edge-case in the new kernel selection for longer sequences. Likely regression in runtime selection logic.
Maya P (deploy-owner): initiating rollback:```sh
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/canary-inference --to-revision=42
```
deploy-bot: Rollout undo initiated for deploy/canary-inference by Maya P. Tracking rollout status...
deploy-bot: Rollout status: 2/6 updated, 0/6 available.
infra-bot: Autoscaler paused for canary group during rollback to prevent flapping.
Ryan S (sre): adding a temporary mitigation: disable quant-path selection flag for canary via configmap patch:```sh
kubectl -n inference patch cm runtime-config -p '{"data":{"force_legacy_kernels":"true"}}'
```
Maya P (deploy-owner): patch applied, will let new pods spin up with legacy kernels. Watching metrics.
Dana L (oncall): p95 and 5xx trending down?
Ryan S (sre): initial numbers: 5xx dropped from 28% -> 6% over last 60s. p95 latency back to baseline ~120ms.
deploy-bot: Rollout undo complete. all replicas at revision 42.
Maya P (deploy-owner): rollback successful. will hold release and open a blocking PR to revert the kernel-selection change.
Jenn K (product): please prepare an internal blurb for support and two-line customer note in case we need it. Also any impacted SLAs?
Dana L (oncall): no global customer-facing outage detected beyond canary cohort. Support reported 3 customers seeing transient 503s. I've asked support to reach out to affected accounts with the standby blurb.
Ryan S (sre): creating an incident ticket in JIRA: INF-8745 with logs, repro steps, and assignment to infra/runtime.
Maya P (deploy-owner): next steps: revert PR, add unit test for kernel selection with long sequences, and run extended canary in staging. I'll block the release train until root cause fixed.
Jenn K (product): noted. Schedule postmortem if we need one, but seems contained. Requesting follow-up in 24h with RCA.
Dana L (oncall): closing the PagerDuty incident now. Will set a watch for 1 hour and hand off to daytime SRE rotation. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC12345 resolved by Dana L. Incident duration: 00:12:40.
Ryan S (sre): quick ack — leaving the monitoring dashboards open and will monitor traces for 30m.
Maya P (deploy-owner): adding checklist entry: "canary kernel-selection stress test" to our deploy runbook.
Jenn K (product): thanks team. When you have the JIRA and PR links drop them here and I'll liaise with support.
Dana L (oncall): will add links. closing thread for now but will reopen if we see regression.
